from: 2. You can generate a Credit Invoice for a shop with a configured disclaimer.
to: 2. A credit raised from an invoice, at a shop that has a disclaimer configured. To make one: click "Parts" in the top menu, click "Part Sales", open a part sale whose status is "paid", click the "Finance" tab, click the three-dot button on that tab's toolbar and choose "Issue Credit". That window lists the parts under "Parts to return" with a "Qty To Credit" and a "Restocking Fee" for each; set a quantity, choose "Issue Store Credit" under "Outcome", type a short note in "Reason", and click "Issue Credit". The credit that appears carries the invoice's number, which is what makes it the right kind for this case.
